tasks.name: 드라마 상세 회차 권한 JOIN 및 DB 정렬
tasks.summary: Added optional userUuid validation and lookup, an episode entitlement LEFT JOIN, DB-side publication filtering and episodeNumber ordering, and episodes[].isUnlocked. Updated API docs and Postman coverage for owned/unowned users, anonymous requests, and invalid or missing users. Read-only inspection confirmed existing fixtures; no DB writes were made. lint and build passed; the full test run passed 68 unit tests and 127 API assertions using documented Postman --env-var forwarding. Standalone API tests passed with the same fixture values.
